scientific.integrity: The theorem substitutes the source Student-t weight into the source pseudo-count recurrence at its exact inlier fixed point. The resulting rational influence curve is maximized analytically in the source Mahalanobis geometry and specialized to sparse block outliers.
limitations: Single outlier following exact-inlier pseudo-count equilibration.
Previous diagonal second-moment scale is frozen for the first-momentum influence calculation.
First-momentum theorem rather than a complete parameter-trajectory theorem.
Block-size specialization uses the source default degrees of freedom equal to block dimension.

title: TAdam has a sharp block-size outlier response law
